description: Registry consumed by earning-health-allslots.sh (self-heal-allslots spec). One entry PER REQUIRED earn slot -- adding barren-earning detection to a new slot means adding one entry here (+ instrumenting that slot's own run.sh to emit {"action":"skip","reason":"..."} lines on a genuine mechanism rejection), never copy-pasting a new *-healthcheck.sh. instrumented:false entries are DOCUMENTED GAPS (see gapNote) -- the script logs them as NOT-INSTRUMENTED, never fabricates an OK/BARREN verdict for data that does not exist.

slots.gapNote: gig-core already has its own process-alive/heartbeat-STALE check (gig-healthcheck.sh); no per-wake {action,reason} mechanism-skip trace exists yet in gig-cli.sh/applied.jsonl/earnings.jsonl. Needs the STARTUP pass to append a stable skip/reason line on a genuine mechanism rejection (e.g. login/captcha failure) before this check can safely activate.

hl_trade shares skills/earn/state/earn-ledger.jsonl (source=hl-trade) with every other skills/earn/run.sh strategy; its 'task' field is free text (hl-cooldown/hl-observe/hl-fund-skipped/...), not a stable {action,reason} pair, so is_fresh_but_barren cannot distinguish a genuine sustained WAIT/HOLD from a mechanism failure without per-strategy text-matching (brittle judgment, not deterministic bookkeeping). Needs run.sh's hl branch to tag mechanism-rejection paths with a dedicated action:skip,reason field.

x402_sell's run.sh branch only ever writes narrate lines (server-up heartbeat); '0 realized gain in N runs' is its EXPECTED steady state until a buyer appears (no bug to fix), so applying is_fresh_but_barren here without a genuine mechanism-vs-no-demand distinction would misdirect self-fix at a market problem, not a code problem. Needs an explicit mechanism-failure signal (e.g. server down / port bind failure) before wiring.

token_launch's run.sh branch only narrates deposit-address/no-launch-decision lines (model-gated, rarely invoked); no per-wake mechanism-rejection signal exists yet to distinguish 'model hasn't decided to launch' (healthy) from a mechanism bug.

clip-core already has its own process-alive/heartbeat-STALE check + give-up task_file marker (clip-healthcheck.sh); its outcome ledger (posts/payout-check) is activity-level, not a per-wake decision trace with a stable skip reason.

video-core already has its own process-alive/heartbeat-STALE check + give-up task_file marker (video-healthcheck.sh); earn-video-ledger.jsonl records realized USDC per post, not a per-wake mechanism-skip trace.
